name: UAP Intel Nexus
description: Refactor this entire project from its current Breaking News structure into the 'UAP Intel Nexus' by modifying the existing files specifically App.tsx and services/newsService.ts and services/geminiService.ts. and all other files in this repository. You must completely strip out any web scraping logic in newsService.ts and replace it with a direct Gemini API call that utilizes the google_search tool in the tools configuration to retrieve the last 48 hours of UAP and UFO reports specifically prioritizing MUFON and NUFORC and The Debrief and AARO.mil. You must update the geminiService.ts to include a text-to-speech function that utilizes the Google Cloud Journey voices specifically allowing the user to pass a voice ID argument of Fenrir or Kore or Charon or Aoede or Zephyr or Puck or Leda or Orus. You must update the App.tsx interface to replace the general news categories with a Voice Selector dropdown that lists these specific names and pass the selected voice to the new audio service. You must also implement the Reporter Mode logic in the AnalysisModal component to take the search results and generate a blog post in the requested styles of Academic or Gonzo or Skeptic or Viral. Maintain the existing Tailwind styling and dark mode aesthetic but update the headers and text to reflect the new classified intelligence theme.
